invariants: Unknowns are never silently converted to facts.
High-impact uncertainty triggers testing, abstention, or escalation.
procedure: Separate observations, inferences, assumptions, unknowns, and policy choices.
Apply the referenced method with visible component values.
Test alternatives, contradictions, and failure conditions.
Emit a bounded result with provenance and residual uncertainty.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Represent observations, inferences, assumptions, disputes, hypotheses, unknowns, confidence, and provenance as an explicit decision-safe state.
title: Epistemic State Manager
when_to_use: Use whenever material information is incomplete, conflicting, probabilistic, stale, or scope-sensitive.
